description: Search-specific text input with a built-in search icon, clear button, optional debounce delay, and localized placeholder fallback.

parameters.name: AutoComplete
parameters.description: HTML autocomplete attribute. Defaults to "off" for search inputs. Common values: "on", "off".

parameters.name: DebounceMs
parameters.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds (0 = no debounce).

parameters.name: OnKeyDown
parameters.description: Raised for every key press in the input. A consumer that owns a list under the search (the email variable picker) uses it for arrow-key navigation. Additive: it never blocks typing, and nothing is prevented by the component itself.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text. When null, falls back to the localized default.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the search value changes. Raised at most once per change: the input element reports a single user edit as both an input and a change event, and the same value is never delivered twice in a row.
